symptom: `describe javascript action` of an action with type parameters (PedApp's NanoflowCommons GetGuid, GetStorageItemObject, …; FeedbackModule.JS_GetFeedbackStorageObject) printed `NanoflowCommons.GetGuid<TypeParameter>` after the action name and `entity <>` for an entity selector bound to no type parameter: neither parses ("mismatched input '<' expecting {FOLDER, '('}"), so `describe module FeedbackModule with all` did not parse either.
cause: describeJavaScriptAction printed the stored TypeParameters as a `<T>` header the grammar never had — MDL declares a type parameter only through an `entity <T>` parameter, as for Java actions. Two stored shapes have no MDL form at all: a parameter typed by T with no `entity <T>` parameter (mendixlabs/mxcli#1404's Java shape), and an EntityTypeParameterType whose TypeParameterPointer is null with TypeParameters empty. Behind the parse error, exec also wrote `list of T` as a list of the entity `.T` (the JavaScript twin of Java's #1183, listOfTypeParameter was never called from the JS write path).
file: mdl/executor/cmd_javascript_actions.go (no header; jsTypeParameterGap comments the statement out under `-- NOT re-executable:`); mdl/executor/cmd_javascript_actions_write.go (listOfTypeParameter for parameters and return type)
insight: Fixing the parse error exposed the next law: GetStorageItemObjectList then parsed but broke getput/putget, which only the roundtrip harness (exec on a copy, unit diff) showed. For a shape MDL cannot express, a statement that parses into something else is worse than a parse error — `T` with no declarer re-executes as the entity `.T` and builds with CE1613 — so commenting the whole statement out keeps the script parseable and the stored action untouched. The commented-out documents pass every harness law vacuously; the gap is the grammar's, not closed.
